summary: Wraps a float a2 into the range [0, this[9]) by repeatedly adding or subtracting the wrap period stored at this+0x24, then classifies the wrapped value against a small descending threshold table rooted at flt_5EA404. Returns the matched segment index (2, 1 or 0), or 0 when the wrapped value exceeds flt_5EA404, or -1 when it exceeds every scanned threshold.

operations.description: Initialize v2 from input a2 and read the wrap period from this[9] (this+0x24).
While v2 is negative, add the wrap period this[9] to move it back toward the [0, period) range.
While v2 exceeds the wrap period this[9], subtract the wrap period to reduce it into range.
If the wrapped v2 is above flt_5EA404, return 0 as the matched segment index.
Scan up to three descending float thresholds beginning at flt_5EA404 (offsets 0, -4, -8); stop at the first threshold that v2 exceeds.
Track the candidate segment index i, counting down from 2 toward 0 for each threshold the value fails to exceed.
Return the matched segment index i (2, 1 or 0), or -1 when v2 exceeded every scanned threshold.
Called by AISessionModeTransition, sub_41B250, PitSelectionStateMachine, sub_4BCCC0 and FloatWrapTableInterpolation on the frame path.
